title: RAG Retrieval Augmentation Hallucination Mitigation
falsifiable_statement: RAG grounding reduces factual hallucination by at least 50% relative to ungrounded generation across multi-seed evaluations.
theoretical_rationale: Grounding queries in factual context passages constraints generative attention to reference tokens.
